scope: Actual iOS simulator and Android emulator; synthetic files and accounts; no physical or store qualification

osDelivery.ios: XCTest opens a file URL through the OS; waits for actual native pending-ready; actual JS bridge then restores
osDelivery.android: Separate UID test activity/provider issues VIEW and SEND with URI grant; actual bridge restores, then repeated SEND yields handled receipt

limitations: Simulator/emulator only; physical document provider behavior remains a release gate.
Storage-failure tests use actual invalid private filesystem path, not physical full-volume exhaustion.
Download cleanup rejection uses an explicit injected deletion callback; real SQLite rollback and subsequent actual file deletion/reopen are exercised.
Runtime product UI flow is recorded separately after final product asset build.
